intro.title: Kovax playground
intro.import: Components import from src/ via the kovax-react alias — library changes show up here immediately.
intro.docs: Full copy from docs/ (props tables, guides) lives under Documentation in the header. Live component demos: Components, then pick an item in the sidebar.
intro.tabs: Each example has Preview and Code tabs.
intro.runBody: From the repo root: npm install, then npm run dev:playground (production build: npm run build:playground). Extra Vite flags: npm run dev -w kovax-playground -- --host.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.lead: Markdown from the repo docs/ folder: imports, props tables, and examples from the packaged docs.

hints.foundation: README, Getting Started, Tokens, Design system

layout.intro: One block per primitive from docs/components/Layout/: a props table (from the docs) and a live example. Full prose lives under header Documentation → Layout.
layout.stackHint: HStack / VStack share the same props; VStack defaults to align="stretch".
layout.flexCenterHint: Composition pattern: Flex defines the region; Center centers its child.

typography.intro: Text primitives backed by sizes.text tokens. Full reference — header Documentation → Typography.

button.intro: Button variants and loading state. Props tables — header Documentation → Button.

input.intro: Inputs at different sizes and color schemes. Reference — header Documentation → Input.

form.intro: Label, field, helper text, and error wiring. Reference — header Documentation → Form.
